incidents.name: RL LP incentive airdrop reward miscalculation
incidents.notes: RLLpIncentive's airDropReward(address) pays out from the caller's current LP balance rather than a recorded stake, so the attacker shuttled the same LP position through many freshly created claimer contracts and collected the reward repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: RLLpIncentive 0x335ddcE3f07b0bdaFc03F56c1b30D3b269366666 created 2022-07-24T14:15:50Z by 0xbce322ea285d8f6f84b46590448dc9c35bbbf2f6, unrelated to attack sender 0x08e08f4b701d33c253ad846868424c1f3c9a4db3; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 9,028.50 USDT left the RL/USDT pair 0xD9578d4009D9CC284B32D19fE58FfE5113c04A5e to the attacker.
